mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% annualized over the previous two months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with sustained HOUST increase.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals a tightening labor market, which increases corporate costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% year-over-year, it indicates a restrictive monetary policy in a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening in a slowing economy
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are positive in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals increased economic activity, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 over the previous month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow by more than 5% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4%, it indicates strong consumer demand in a tight labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: strong consumer demand in a tight labor market
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25 percentage points in a month signals a shift towards accommodative monetary policy, which reduces borrowing costs and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward returns are negative in > 60% of triggered instances.
